title: 第3章 断指一夜生老丑应一月之约第4章老丑下山冰美人送货上门
content_zh:
老丑闻言心头猛地一紧。
守备总管已带着几名护卫快步冲入牢房，目光扫过野狗尸体和满地血迹。脸色阴沉地盯视老丑。
“来人！给我拿下此贼！”
老丑心头狂跳，立刻丢下手中匕首，跪倒在地：“大人，大人明鉴，小的……”
“狗杂种！”总管不待他说完，一脚将他踹翻在地：“其余人随我去大堂。主人有话要问。”
一刻钟后，仙宫正殿。
苏若雪端坐在主位之上，一袭浅蓝长裙，腰肢束得极细，领口微敞，露出一截精致雪白的锁骨。神色清冷，气质高华，却带着不容置疑的威严。
老丑与李家兄弟一起跪在堂下，大气不敢出。
苏若雪目光扫过堂下三人，最后落在了老丑身上。
“咦？又是你！”她声音不大，却如寒刀般锋利，“重狱五个犯人，一死四逃。你来此地效力多久了？”
老丑额头紧贴冰冷的地面，声音颤抖却清晰：“回主上，小人老丑，来此不足一月。”
“不足一月便出了这偌大的乱子？”苏若雪轻笑一声，眼中却毫无笑意，“大胆老丑！在本座面前还敢撒谎！”
她玉手轻抬，淡淡道：
“来呀，断他两指。”
老丑心头剧震。
好个心狠手辣的妖女！
守备总管闻言毫不犹豫，一亮匕首，拽过老丑的左手，“咔嚓”一声！
无名指与小指齐根而断，鲜血顿时狂涌而出。
剧烈的疼痛瞬间炸开，痛得老丑全身痉挛，冷汗如雨，却死咬牙关，不发一声。
守备总管把匕首往他喉头一递：“主人面前，还敢狡辩！”

老丑强忍剧痛，不看眼前匕首，声音沙哑却坚定：
“主上！小老儿冤枉啊！突发此事，小老儿虽浴血搏杀。”边说边指向肩膀自残的伤口，“但依旧走脱了贼人，理应受罚。但事已至此，应先追拿逃犯为上。小老儿愿立下重誓——一月之内，必将四名逃犯全部擒回！若不能做到，甘愿领死！求主上成全！”
大殿内一片寂静。
守备总管进言道：“主上，此贼，言语有虚，伤口似伪，恐其有诈，不可不防！”
苏若雪闻言只是一瞥。并未说话。
守备总管怒道：“好个老狗，主人面前还敢夸口，主上，待我对他施以极刑，他必会招来！”
老丑急道：“主上！小老儿虽贱，但在这牢狱里泡了月余，那几名犯人的习性、人脉、小老二我颇多了解。绝不敢夸口啊，主上，望主上明鉴。“说完眼角含泪磕头如捣蒜。一派忠义之相！
苏若雪秀眉微挑，心道，小小丑鬼，尔欲使诈，我岂有不知？
不过此刻贼人走脱，至宝下落不明。我倒要试你一试，看你有何本领！
她沉吟片刻，这才缓缓开口：
content_en:
Old Scandal Yan's heart suddenly tightened.
The guard chief had rushed into the cell with several guards, his eyes scanning the wild dog corpses and blood stains on the ground. He stared at the old man with a gloomy face.
"Come here! Capture this thief for me!"
Lao Chou's heart was beating wildly, and he immediately dropped the dagger in his hand and knelt on the ground: "My lord, my lord is wise, little one..."
"You bastard!" The manager didn't wait for him to finish, and kicked him to the ground: "The rest of you will follow me to the lobby. The master has something to ask."
A quarter of an hour later, the main hall of the Immortal Palace.
Su Ruoxue was sitting on the main seat, wearing a light blue dress with an extremely thin waist and a slightly open neckline, revealing a delicate white collarbone. His expression was cold, his temperament was noble, but he carried an unquestionable majesty.
Lao Chou and the Li brothers knelt in the hall together, not daring to express their anger.
Su Ruoxue's eyes swept across the three people in the hall, and finally landed on Lao Chou.
"Eh? It's you again!" Her voice was low but as sharp as a cold knife, "Five prisoners in heavy prison, one died and four escaped. How long have you been working here?"
Lao Chou's forehead was pressed against the cold ground, and his voice was trembling but clear: "Back to the Lord, I am a villain, Lao Chou, I have been here less than a month."
"Such a big mess happened in less than a month?" Su Ruoxue chuckled, but there was no smile in her eyes, "How dare you lie in front of me!"
She raised her jade hand gently and said calmly:
"Come on, cut off two of his fingers."
Lao Chou was shocked.
What a cruel and ruthless witch!
The guard chief did not hesitate when he heard this. He flashed his dagger and took the old man's left hand, making a "click" sound!
The ring finger and little finger were cut off at the same time, and blood suddenly poured out.
The severe pain exploded instantly, causing Lao Chou's whole body to convulse and sweat like rain, but he gritted his teeth without making a sound.
The chief guard put the dagger at his throat: "How dare you quibble in front of the master!"
Lao Chou endured the severe pain, did not look at the dagger in front of him, and said in a hoarse but firm voice:
"My lord! The little old man is unjust! This incident happened. Although the little old man fought with blood," he said, pointing to the self-inflicted wound on his shoulder, "he still escaped from the thief, so he deserves to be punished. But now that the matter has come to this, the first thing to do is to pursue the fugitives. The little old man is willing to make a strong oath - within one month, he will capture all four fugitives! If he cannot do it, he is willing to die! May the Lord grant it!"
There was silence in the hall.
The chief of the garrison added: "My lord, this thief's words are false and his wounds appear to be false. I'm afraid he may be deceitful, so we must be on guard!"
When Su Ruoxue heard this, she just glanced at it. Didn't speak.
The guard chief said angrily: "What an old dog, he still dares to boast in front of his master. Lord, when I punish him with death, he will definitely attract it!"
The old Chou said anxiously: "My lord! Although I am a lowly little man, I have been in this prison for more than a month. I know a lot about the habits, connections and the little brother of those prisoners. I will never boast, my lord. I hope you can learn from me." After saying this, he kowtowed with tears in his eyes like pounding garlic. A sign of loyalty!
Su Ruoxue raised her eyebrows slightly and thought to herself, "You little clown, you want to trick me, how could I not know it?"
But now the thief escaped and the whereabouts of the treasure were unknown. I want to give you a try and see what you are capable of!
She pondered for a moment, then slowly spoke:
